package.name: racer_safety
package.description: C++ safety layer 3 (roadmap milestone 1, claude-docs/05-safety.md): safety_node is the SOLE publisher of /drive. Gates /drive_raw -> /drive with a staleness watchdog, command sanity + bounds/rate-limit clamping (vehicle_params-sourced), TTC braking from /scan, a global speed cap, and a stubbed covariance gate (TODO roadmap task 2.6: no /pose source exists yet). Emits racer_msgs/SafetyEvent on every intervention. Gate/decision logic (include/racer_safety/gate_logic.hpp) is ROS-free and gtest-unit-tested per claude-docs/12-testing.md L1, separated from safety_node.cpp's ROS plumbing.
